<thought>To locate a suitable retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using only the functional groups that are broken in the forward reaction (ketones and C‑C triple bonds). This avoids the need to specify bond indices, which the tool requires in a specific format.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
